import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0110 (f : ℕ → M) (a b c : ℕ) : ∏ x ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f x = ∏ x ∈ Finset.Ico (a + c) (b + c), f (x - c) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0110 (f : ℕ → M) (a b c : ℕ) : ∏ x ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f x = ∏ x ∈ Finset.Ico (a + c) (b + c), f (x - c) := by
  rw [Finset.prod_Ico_add_right_sub_eq]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0110 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0110 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0110

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0110
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0110
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
